verdict.rationale: Godot's official docs have a dedicated command-line tutorial for working entirely from the terminal, and the probe confirms this as the official CLI. A runtime probe shows a one-command keyless Homebrew install of the binary, which runs `godot --headless` for CI builds, exports and scripted editor automation; the docs also cover headless display-server operation. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of specific CLI flags and subcommands (e.g. export and script-run options), and any AI-agent-oriented CLI features such as structured or machine-readable output.
